shots.focal_element: A rounded-corner Moz Pro 'Explore by Keyword' browser capture floating on a purple-to-light-blue diagonal gradient; the attention target moves with the VO (nav item, keyword input, Analyze button, metric cards, suggestion bubbles, SERP analysis table), each marked by an orange outline box

shots.typography: All text is the product's own UI (no added captions): a clean humanist sans throughout; page title 'Explore by Keyword' bold, title case; section headings bold sentence case with the query in quotes; card labels small medium-weight sentence case; metric values as large regular-weight numerals beside small ring gauges; chips and the 'Moz AI' badge as tiny semibold pill labels; normal tracking. Font guess (low confidence): Lato. Many table rows, URLs and helper captions are too small to read at sheet resolution.
shots.what_happens: One 85.6 s continuous edited screen-capture walkthrough. 12-13.5 s: wide view, cursor goes to the left nav and 'Keyword Research' gets an orange highlight box (w43-w45); 14-16.5 s: a flyout opens and 'Explore by Keyword' is boxed and clicked (w46-w52). ~17.5 s: the camera zooms in on the keyword input and 'how to give my dog a haircut' is typed (w53-w61); ~19.5 s it pans right to the market dropdown and Analyze button, which gets an orange box and is clicked (w62-w72). 23.5-24.5 s: the results load from grey skeleton bars into the overview cards as the view zooms back out (w73-w83). An orange line draws on and becomes a box around Monthly Volume (~27.5-28 s, w84-w89) and an illustrated calendar sticker pops onto the card (30.5-33.5 s, w90-w102); the box moves to Difficulty (~35.5 s, w103-w107) and an illustrated blue character sticker pops beside it (38-41.5 s, w108-w119). ~42.5 s an enlarged 'AI Overview' chip drops into SERP Features (w120-w137). 50.5-51.5 s the page scrolls to Keyword Suggestions bubble clusters (w152-w161); a pastel faceted gem sticker sits between the Top suggestions and Questions panels (53.5-58 s, w158-w173). 61-65.5 s the cursor hovers a Questions bubble, opening a stats tooltip, with a round photo-avatar sticker beside it (w174-w197). ~68-69.5 s it scrolls to the SERP Analysis table (w198-w205); an orange box draws around the PA/DA/BA gauges of row 1 (74-78.5 s, w224-w232) and a small device/illustration sticker appears at the right edge near Page Score (79-82 s, w233-w243); at 81.5-83.5 s the cursor moves onto the table's SERP-feature chips (w244-w256). The rest of the shot (83.5-97.4 s, w257-w296) was not in the sheets I was given.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a pre-recorded UI capture inside a rounded-rect frame (about 92% of the frame width) over a diagonal purple-to-light-blue gradient, keyframe a 2D camera (scale 1 to ~2.2 and back, translateX/Y with ease-in-out over ~0.6 s) onto each element the VO names, and at each named word draw an orange 2 px stroke rectangle (line draw-on ~0.3 s, then hold) around the target and pop a small illustrated sticker (scale 0 to 1, slight overshoot) next to it, removing both before the next cue.
